evals.name: folder-hash-parity
evals.prompt: I'm about to refactor how aghub computes the skill folder hash in crates/skill/src/hash.rs. Before I touch it, I need to understand exactly what the upstream vercel `skills` CLI does for its folder hash so I don't break cross-tool compatibility. Walk me through the upstream algorithm and call out anything subtle that aghub must keep byte-identical.
evals.expected_output: Explains upstream computeSkillFolderHash (local-lock.ts): recurse skipping .git/node_modules, files only, sort by relativePath via JS localeCompare, sha256 of relativePath+raw bytes with NO delimiter. Flags the subtle point that aghub's match depends on feruca Collator with shifting=false to reproduce localeCompare, and that copyDirectory/Master exclusions + the golden parity tests must stay aligned.

evals.name: install-universal-vs-copy
evals.prompt: When aghub installs a skill in universal mode, I want to know how it lines up with what `npx skills add` actually does for a single (skill, agent) pair. Walk me through the upstream install step by step and tell me which aghub function mirrors each step. Also: how does upstream decide whether to make a symlink vs a copy?
evals.expected_output: Walks upstream installSkillForAgent (installer.ts): sanitize+path-safety, copy mode vs symlink mode, materialize Master to ~/.agents/skills canonicalDir, skip symlink for global universal agents and for absent project agent dirs, createSymlink with copy-on-failure fallback. Maps to aghub install_universal -> copy_dir_recursive + link_agents_to_canonical (crates/core/src/skills/linker/mod.rs), relative (project) vs absolute (global) links, and notes aghub is symlink-only: the Master lives in .aghub (read by no agent), every agent gets a Referrer, there is no copy mode or copy fallback (a failed link lands in UniversalInstallReport.failed), and add_skill / --universal just delegate to the universal path.

evals.name: update-rename-guard
evals.prompt: A teammate asked why aghub's `apply-update` refuses to update a skill that was renamed in its source, while `npx skills update` seems to just go ahead. Trace both update flows and explain the difference.
evals.expected_output: Explains upstream update.ts (updateGlobalSkills): fetch tree, hash-diff against skillFolderHash, then re-runs `add` via spawnSync — no rename guard, so a renamed skill can orphan the old Master/Referrers. Explains aghub: check (offline default / --online via run_update_check, reporting Renamed) + apply-update through resync_installed_skill, whose detect_rename guard refuses the update (CLI skill_renamed_message / `source accept-rename` hint, API SKILL_RENAMED_IN_SOURCE) before the staged DirSwapTransaction swap and lock re-stamp with rollback. Identifies the rename guard as the deliberate aghub safety addition.
